# Field program — agent handoff (first customer)

**Status:** Shipped on `main` @ `2b40af0` (Epics A0–D). Close remaining open issues #423–452 when process allows.  
**Return day:** [`field-release-checklist.md`](./field-release-checklist.md) on Android Chrome PWA + concierge notebook migration.  
**Locked decisions:** [`prd-field-program-decisions.md`](./prd-field-program-decisions.md).  
**Issue registry:** [`field-program-issues.json`](./field-program-issues.json) (generated by `node scripts/publish-field-program-issues.mjs`)

---

## Start here (agents)

1. Read [`prd-field-program-decisions.md`](./prd-field-program-decisions.md) (locked defaults).
2. Open [`field-program-issues.json`](./field-program-issues.json) — find your slice `#` or epic parent `#`.
3. Read the epic PRD listed on the issue.
4. Branch from **`feat/<slug>`** (not `main`). See issue body for branch name.
5. Run **`implement-issue`** workflow or: implement → test → PR to epic branch → stop before merge.
6. QA: [`field-release-checklist.md`](./field-release-checklist.md).

**Do not** implement from [`prd-first-customer-field-technician.md`](./prd-first-customer-field-technician.md) directly — it is discovery only.

---

## Program goal

Replace the customer’s **notebook** with a phone app that works **offline**, opens on **Hoy**, captures in **Anotar**, and sends proof via **WhatsApp** — before he returns from vacation.

---

## Epic order & integration branches

Merge to **`main`** **one epic at a time** (sequential production releases).

| Order | Epic | Branch | PRD | Slice count |
|------:|------|--------|-----|-------------|
| 0 | Bottom tabs | `feat/field-bottom-tabs` | [`prd-field-bottom-tabs.md`](./prd-field-bottom-tabs.md) | 4 |
| 1 | Solo / Hoy home | `feat/technician-solo-mode` | [`prd-technician-solo-mode.md`](./prd-technician-solo-mode.md) | 5 |
| 2 | Offline jobs | `feat/offline-first-jobs` | [`prd-offline-first-jobs.md`](./prd-offline-first-jobs.md) | 6 |
| 3 | Anotar capture | `feat/job-capture-anotar` | [`prd-job-capture-anotar.md`](./prd-job-capture-anotar.md) | 6 |
| 4 | Send & cobro | `feat/field-send-cobro` | [`prd-field-send-cobro.md`](./prd-field-send-cobro.md) | 5 |

**Total:** ~26 slice PRs + 5 epic PRs → `main`.

Slice catalog (machine-readable): [`field-program-slices.json`](./field-program-slices.json)

## Dependency graph (high level)

```text
A0 Bottom tabs ─────────────────────────────┐
                                            ├──► A Solo mode (Hoy UI)
                                            │
A0 ──► C Anotar UI (online) ──► C + B offline wire-up
B Offline store ──► B sync ──► B Hoy merge
A Solo + C jobs ──► D Send / cobro on Hoy
```

## Commands

```bash
# Publish / refresh GitHub issues (maintainers, once)
node scripts/publish-field-program-issues.mjs

# Start epic branch
git fetch origin main
git checkout -b feat/field-bottom-tabs origin/main
git push -u origin feat/field-bottom-tabs

# Implement slice (example)
# gh issue view <slice#>
git checkout -b slice/field-tabs-nav feat/field-bottom-tabs
npm test -- --runInBand
npm run lint
npm run test:e2e:mobile   # when PRD requires
```
